scope: Read-only second-output analysis using existing Full0 NPZ and previously computed three-replica labels; no new trajectories, inference, training, figure or manuscript changes.

units.Hchi: nats, natural-log joint side-chain categorical state entropy
units.delta: G12D minus WT; compare only unchanged same-amino-acid positions with valid chi labels in both states

selection_policy.HLA: All HLA residues within 6.0 A heavy-atom distance of peptide P6 in either static input; Q70/R114/D116 always explicitly included.
selection_policy.TCR: All TCR residues within 4.5 A heavy-atom distance of any peptide atom in either input; additionally alpha R50/K70 named in original study are included.
selection_policy.peptide: All 10 positions shown, invalid and mutation-type-confounded comparisons explicitly null.

assessment.reason: Hchi adds location-specific side-chain information, but does not yet give a sufficiently clear additional affinity-mechanism conclusion to justify a main panel. Mixed side-chain responses or differences from RMSF are not failures: the outputs measure different properties and stronger affinity does not require all side chains to order.
assessment.positive_information: Q70/D116 lower Hchi is consistent with altered pocket-side-chain constraints; K10 shows a decrease. Different side-chain responses could complement backbone suppression as evidence of local dynamical redistribution.
assessment.negative_information: R114 does not decrease, whereas the existing MD labels decrease with non-overlapping replica ranges. TCR beta H101/N102 also increase in the prediction but decrease in existing MD. V8 slightly increases despite reduced backbone RMSF. Most central peptide positions are Gly/Ala without chi, and G6 vs D6 cannot be compared at fixed amino-acid type.
assessment.independent_information_relative_to_RMSF: Side-chain joint-state diversity is different from backbone positional fluctuations. Q70/D116 change Hchi while their backbone RMSF changes are small; V8 shows lower backbone RMSF and nearly unchanged/slightly higher Hchi. This is independent dynamical content, but it does not by itself make the affinity-mechanism claim stronger.
assessment.R114_interpretation: Nearly unchanged coarse joint-state entropy does not imply that the D6-R114 salt bridge is absent. Specific state identity or contact geometry may change without changing the entropy summary. The crystallographic contact is independently established by the original article.
assessment.MD_role: The existing MD labels are supplementary evidence with their own replica variability, not an absolute truth used alone to accept or reject the model story.
limitations: Joint Hchi does not identify a specific chi angle, salt-bridge occupancy, electrostatic energy or affinity.
Gly/Ala model slots are masked placeholders; they must never be graphed as physically meaningful side-chain entropy.
Bound-state Hchi differences do not measure the entropy change on binding; no unbound state is analyzed.
Reported MD labels are existing independent ITrace analyses, with per-replica variability shown rather than treated as exact truth.
